Search box to workflow copilot
## Summary
This paper describes how Algolia’s retrieval and ranking layer powers an enterprise intent router. The platform supplies the indexed tool catalog, ranks candidates under policy constraints, and stays fast enough that the orchestration layer above can turn natural language into safe, auditable action without leaving the critical path.
